officialNginxReview.basis: Current fixed image and actual package version 1.30.6-r1; official 2026-10-14 CHANGES-1.30 fixes the five formerly unreviewed publisher advisories. Three fresh native scans/BOMs bind the new exact images. This does not approve the old 1.30.5 images or establish licensing/runtime/release acceptance.

dispositions.name: zlib
dispositions.reason: CVE-2026-85091 requires stalled nonblocking gzwrite followed by gzprintf/gzvprintf using the gz writer state. Exact NGINX 1.30.6 is dynamically linked to libz but contains no imports of these gz writer names; its official gzip filter source uses deflateInit2/deflate/deflateEnd. Fixed configs load no additional native modules and expose no gz writer API. No waiver for different packages, code or configurations.
dispositions.limits: Only exact source/config digest, these immutable product images and their shared base layers. No alternative configuration/entrypoint, root shell or host compromise. New finding or drift blocks.
